markdown.intro: This is the Python-Markdown library (Python 3, no dependencies). Run the tests with `python3 run_tests.py`.

more-itertools.intro: This is the more-itertools library (Python 3, no dependencies). Run the tests with `python3 run_tests.py`.

sqlparse.intro: This is the sqlparse library (Python 3, no dependencies). Run the tests with `PYTHONPATH=. python3 -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests`.

packaging.intro: This is the `packaging` library (Python 3, no dependencies; the code is in `src/packaging/`). Run the tests with `PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests --ignore=tests/property` (about a minute).
